response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount - spent) AS avg_leftover FROM budget) SELECT b.event_status AS status, AVG(b.amount - b.spent) AS avg_leftover, AVG(b.amount - b.spent) - o.avg_leftover AS difference_from_overall FROM budget AS b CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_leftover IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.event_status
